KIIT Founder Samanta Receives 75th Honorary Doctorate

Achyuta Samanta, founder of KIIT University, received his 75th honorary doctorate from a foreign university. The event took place on February 10, 2023, in the United States. Samanta was awarded the degree by the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. This is the fifth time he has received an honorary doctorate from the US university. The award recognizes Samanta's contributions to education and social reform.
